title: Junior HR Consultant
description_md:
**Junior HR Consultant**

*Do you thrive on structured work, have an eye for detail,**and take pride in providing excellent service?* *Then you might be the Junior HR Consultant we are looking for at Netcompany Talent Acquisition. The position is based at Netcompany’s headquarters in Copenhagen, where you will join a highly motivated team that balances ambitious goals with a fun and* *collaborative* *work environment.*

**A challenging role with responsibility**

As our Junior HR Consultant, you will play a central role for our Talent Acquisition Consultants, ensuring the smooth scheduling of our many recruitment interviews across. Your communication with candidates and managers will be an important part of the process, helping to create a positive and professional experience for both candidates and colleagues alike.

Specifically, your tasks will include:

* Coordinating and scheduling recruitment interviews with candidates across departments and offices
* Supporting recruitment processes in collaboration with HR colleagues and different stakeholders
* Reviewing and screening candidate applications and CVs, as well as supporting candidate sourcing through LinkedIn Recruiter
* Administering and providing feedback to candidates
* Ad hoc HR tasks as needed

**Become our new colleague**

As a person, you are service-minded and solution-oriented, and you take pride in completing your tasks thoroughly and efficiently. You are a team player who likes to make a difference together with your colleagues. You are responsible and structured, with a good overview, and remain calm, positive and focused – even during busy periods.

Furthermore, we imagine that you:

* Have a strong interest in Talent Acquisition and HR administration, and are motivated to develop your skills within both areas
* Are currently enrolled in a bachelor degree, preferably with at least one year of studies completed
* Are able to work approximately 16 hours per week alongside your studies – we are flexible during exam periods
* Are well-formulated and fluent in Danish and English, both written and spoken

You will naturally receive the support and sparring you need, and we ensure a thorough introduction to both tasks and colleagues.

**Become part of an inclusive community**

At Netcompany, we place a high priority on community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture built on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

It is part of our culture and values that all employees, regardless of different backgrounds, identities, and experiences, are met with understanding and respect, as well as equal opportunities for development and well-being.

You will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues across cultures and nationalities, as we are an international company with offices in many countries.

We offer a collaborative environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that give you the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

**Send us an application**

Upload your CV, a motivated application, and academic transcripts to our recruitment system via the link. If you have any remaining questions, feel free to write directly to [hr.dk@netcompany.com](mailto:hr.dk@netcompany.com).

*All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.*

*We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you need adjustments or additional support during the recruitment process, please email our responsible recruitment team at* [*reasonableadjustmentsdk@netcompany.com*](mailto:reasonableadjustmentsdk@netcompany.com) *for assistance.* *#LI-SA1*
